courses.title: Executive Presentations That Land
courses.description: Executive Presentations That Land takes you from the basics of executive presentation skills to applying it on a realistic Consultant scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to change management, enough to use it alongside executive presentation skills day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying executive presentation skills to a real Consultant scenario
Practicing executive presentation skills through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to change management
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Data Storytelling for Practitioners
courses.description: Data Storytelling for Practitioners is a focused course on data storytelling for people already working toward a Consultant role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying data storytelling on your own.
learning_outcomes: Applying data storytelling to a real Consultant scenario
Practicing data storytelling through guided exercises
Building a short data storytelling exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Vendor Management in Brief
courses.description: Vendor Management in Brief is a short introduction to vendor management for people moving toward a Consultant role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show vendor management in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if vendor management is new to you.

alternates.title: Advanced Executive Presentation Skills Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Executive Presentation Skills Techniques goes beyond the basics of executive presentation skills, for people already working toward a Consultant role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in executive presentation skills and want to go further.
